title: The Last Promise
author: Yara Okafor
blurb: Jonah Halloran, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, has spent fifteen years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
